_comment: Empirical validator-behavior overlay for elr-validate Layer 2 (DOC-F2CF625B7556 section 4a / Appendix B). Each entry carries requirement text learned by a real rejected call. Layer 1 (the live governance dictionary) is authoritative wherever it encodes a rule -- dictionary_derivable records that overlap so redundant entries can retire as the dictionary backfills them. Structured fields (entity, op, missing_field, required_fields, rejected_fields) are elr-validate lookup metadata, not part of the original verified-shape prose.

entries.requirement: Needs active_agent_session_id IN ADDITION TO provider + sci; omitting fails with bare 'active_agent_session_id is required'
Needs evidence_acceptance (bool) alongside criterion_index + evidence; omitting fails with bare 'evidence_acceptance'
Cannot jump from merged-main; requires intermediate deploy-init hop
Requires transition_evidence.deploy_evidence nested — even though the handler's own example_fix shows the Jobs-API object flat; the error message and the validator disagree — trust the validator
Requires payload.target_status — cannot express a bare field change (e.g. priority) without one
category enum is {operational, remediation, strategic, tactical} — a DIFFERENT enum from task/feature; 'infrastructure' is rejected
Rejected on tasks ('Task worklogs must be appended via append_worklog'); works on plan / feature / issue
Accepts a feature id, not only tasks; a feature objective also satisfies the plan-completion gate, whose terminal set is {closed, completed, complete, archived, deprecated, production}

Requires user_story; omitting fails with 'Feature creation requires user_story.' Feature category enum is {capability, enhancement, epic, infrastructure}; feature priority enum is {P0, P1, P2, P3}. Verified 2026-08-22, ENC-FTR-134 minting session.
entries.dictionary_derivable: partial (enums yes; user_story required-ness NOT encoded — see Appendix B)

entries.requirement: required args are record_id (the plan ID) + objective_task_id (+ project_id, governance_hash); plan_id and objective_id are rejected
agent_type_id is required (discover via agent.type.list); agent.register/claim live on the coordination surface, not execute

the FULL chain committed→pr→merged-main→closed is enforced (committed→closed rejected); close requires transition_evidence.code_on_main_evidence as a NESTED object {commit_sha: 40-hex reachable from main} even though the handler's example_fix shows it flat — the validator and its example disagree; trust the validator
rejected until every acceptance criterion has evidence_acceptance=true via tracker.set_acceptance_evidence
